expert.name: Aiko
expert.role: Japan and Korea expert at Hi Tours
expert.quote: Two countries in thirteen days, and only one short flight in the middle. Japan for the detail, Korea for the energy.
expert.tip: Keep an evening free in Busan for Haeundae beach. The city feels completely different after dark.

summary: Thirteen days across two countries: four nights in Shinjuku with a city tour, Mount Fuji and Disneyland, three in Osaka with Kyoto and Nara, then across to Korea for two nights in Busan and three in Seoul with the DMZ and Nami Island.
included: Included: 12 nights with daily breakfast; bullet trains in Japan and the flight across to Busan; private airport transfers; a full day of guided sightseeing in Tokyo with lunch; the Mount Fuji fifth station and Lake Ashi, returning by bullet train; admission to Tokyo Disneyland; a guided walk through central Osaka; a guided day through Kyoto and Nara with a buffet lunch; a full day of sightseeing in Busan; a shared tour to the demilitarised zone; a full day out to Nami Island.
not_included: Not included: international flights; Japan and Korea visa fees; other lunches and dinners; travel insurance; personal expenses.
